name: corella
description: A local browser chat UI for command-line coding agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @corella/shared && npm run build -w @corella/server && npm run build -w @corella/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/shared packages/server && npm run typecheck -w @corella/web
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:server
